+"""Record preparation steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def _validate_record(record: object) -> tuple[str, Any, bool]:
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare_record(record: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict whose ``display``
+    is ``render(value)``; the input is never mutated."""
+    key, value, enabled = _validate_record(record)
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": render(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare ``record`` with ``display`` telling whether its value is an
+    async function (coroutine function or async generator function)."""
+    return prepare_record(record, is_async_function)

@@ -38,3 +38,27 @@ def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Prepare ``record`` with ``display`` telling whether its value is an
     async function (coroutine function or async generator function)."""
     return prepare_record(record, is_async_function)
+
+
+def batch_records(
+    records: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order with ``render``; duplicate trimmed keys,
+    disabled entries included, raise ValueError."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare_record(record, render)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare ``records`` in input order with the async-function display."""
+    return batch_records(records, is_async_function)

+
+def merge_records(
+    left: object, right: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge prepared ``left`` and ``right`` records by trimmed key: right
+    replaces left in place, new right keys append in order."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch_records(left, render)}
+    for item in batch_records(right, render):
+        merged[item["key"]] = item
+    return list(merged.values())
+
+
+def merge(left: object, right: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge ``left`` and ``right`` records with the async-function display."""
+    return merge_records(left, right, is_async_function)
